newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita to write off finance unit loan.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita to write off finance unit loan.

text.p: Japanese consumer electronics group Matsushita Electric Industrial Co said on Tuesday it would write off its 100 billion yen long-term loan to its troubled finance unit, NL Finance Co.
"The decision was made in response to the worsening environment for NL Finance to collect its loans made to real-estate developers in Japan," Matsushita said in a statement.
NL Finance is a wholly owned subsidiary set up in 1992 to collect the loan receivables transferred from the former National Leasing Co, another subsidiary.
Following the write-off, Matsushita will post a special loss of 104 billion yen in its parent results in the current business year ending March 31.
But its parent results will not be affected by the special loss as special gains from stock sales will offset that, the company said.

On a group basis, Matsushita may take additional measures in case it cannot collect on some loans in the current business year, but such allowances will also be offset by profits on the sale of stocks, the company said.
